## How we protect our independence
How we buy, test, and publish, with no manufacturer influence.

### We Buy Our Own Products
We buy every unit ourselves, so manufacturers can't cherry-pick samples. What we test is exactly what you'd get.

![Headphones for testing](https://i.rtings.com/images/testing-img.jpg?format=auto)

### No Paid or Sponsored Reviews
Our in-depth, real-world tests evolve with user feedback, ensuring reviews stay detailed, practical, and relevant.
Our [community votes](/vote) and selects some of the products we review next.

![Comparing product results](https://i.rtings.com/assets/pages/mbBA9aUB/in-depth-tests-medium.jpg?format=auto)

### Transparent Testing Methodology
Each product undergoes the same rigorous tests, and we publish the methods, photos, and videos so you can verify and compare results.

![In-Depth tests](https://i.rtings.com/assets/pages/mbBA9aUB/comparable-results-medium.jpg?format=auto)
